title: Raven targets the Sandman’s family
summary: Raven takes Sandman’s championship and then draws his family into the on-screen conflict. The title chase becomes a struggle over personal loyalty as well as the belt.

chapters.title: Raven becomes world champion
chapters.result: Raven defeats Sandman for the world title.
chapters.context: The championship change begins the central title phase of their rivalry.

chapters.title: Raven brings Sandman’s family into the feud
chapters.result: Lori and Tyler side with Raven in the televised storyline.
chapters.context: The staged family betrayal makes Sandman’s pursuit intensely personal.

chapters.title: Sandman wins Raven’s belt from Richards
chapters.result: Sandman pins Richards in the tag match to win Raven’s championship.
chapters.context: Raven’s substitutes defend his title under the match stipulation, allowing the belt to change without Raven being pinned.

chapters.title: Raven wins the title back
chapters.result: Raven defeats Sandman in the barbed-wire match.
chapters.context: The reversal ends Sandman’s reign after the autumn chapter of the family conflict.
